record.paper_title: Optimal Algorithms for Numerical Integration: Recent Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: For Sobolev approximation based on iid uniformly distributed sample points on a domain D_d subset R^d, do the asymptotic constants in expressions such as lim_{n->infinity} e(P_n,W_p^s(D_d),L_q(D_d)) n^{s/d-(1/p-1/q)+} always exist, and if they exist, do they depend only on the volume of D_d rather than on its shape?

evidence.quote: One possibility is to study the asymptotic constants, such as lim n->infty e(Pn,Wsp(Dd),Lq(Dd )) \u00b7 ns/d-(1/p-1/q)+.
We conjecture that all these asymptotic constants exist and possibly they do not depend on the shape of Dd, only on its volume.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\ge 1$, $s\ge 1$ an integer, and $1\le p,q\le\infty$ with $s/d > (1/p - 1/q)_+$, where $(x)_+ = \max(x,0)$. Let $D_d\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ be a bounded Lipschitz domain, and let $W_p^s(D_d)$ denote the Sobolev space of functions on $D_d$ with smoothness $s$ in $L_p$, equipped with its usual norm; let $L_q(D_d)$ be the target space.

For a set of sample points $P_n=\{x_1,\dots,x_n\}\subset D_d$, define the worst-case $L_q$-approximation error using only function values at $P_n$ by
$$
 e(P_n,W_p^s(D_d),L_q(D_d)) := \inf_{A_n}\ \sup_{\|f\|_{W_p^s(D_d)}\le 1}\ \|f - A_n(f(x_1),\dots,f(x_n))\|_{L_q(D_d)},
$$
where the infimum is over all (possibly nonlinear) reconstruction maps $A_n:\mathbb{R}^n\to L_q(D_d)$. Let $P_n=(X_1,\dots,X_n)$ consist of independent points drawn from the uniform distribution on $D_d$, and consider the (random) error $e(P_n,W_p^s(D_d),L_q(D_d))$ multiplied by the conjectured optimal rate factor $n^{\,s/d-(1/p-1/q)_+}$.

Questions:
(a) Does the limit
$$
 C(D_d,s,p,q) := \lim_{n\to\infty}\, \mathbb{E}\bigl[e(P_n,W_p^s(D_d),L_q(D_d))\bigr]\cdot n^{\,s/d-(1/p-1/q)_+}
$$
exist (in $(0,\infty)$) for every such domain $D_d$ and every admissible choice of $s,p,q$?

(b) If it exists, does $C(D_d,s,p,q)$ depend on $D_d$ only through its $d$-dimensional Lebesgue volume $|D_d|$, and not on the shape of $D_d$?
artifact.category_tag: Asymptotic constants for iid sampling in Sobolev approximation
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., Krieg–Sonnleitner and related papers) establishes the optimal rate $n^{-s/d+(1/p-1/q)_+}$ for iid uniform sampling in Sobolev recovery on Lipschitz domains, but identifies the precise asymptotic constants and their dependence on the domain only through volume as an open direction. No source found establishing existence of these limits or their shape-independence in general.

status_evidence.title: Random points are optimal for the approximation of Sobolev functions
status_evidence.snippet: iid uniformly distributed sampling points are asymptotically as good as optimal sampling points for approximation of Sobolev functions; constants and their dependence noted as further questions.
status_evidence.claim: Optimal rate established; asymptotic constants remain to be characterized.

status_evidence.title: Recovery of Sobolev functions restricted to iid sampling
status_evidence.snippet: Studies recovery of Sobolev functions from iid uniform samples on bounded Lipschitz domains.
status_evidence.claim: Rate results known; precise constants and shape dependence not resolved.
